semantics.belief: Uniform mechanical root support; no pre-root behavioral weighting.
semantics.continuation: Forced root action followed by the named deployed focal, partner and opponent policies.
semantics.count: Diagnostic only; never a score tie-break.
semantics.field: Named deployed players, pinned configurations and binaries; first exact-input decision frozen.
semantics.grading: Best assessed first action under the frozen continuation; coverage is explicit in each key.
semantics.objective: Viewer team makes or sets bid 30; equal success fractions tie.
